  "tokenized_directions": [
    {
      "step": 1,
      "text": "Cut {{ing_01|chicken}} into small pieces, add {{ing_02|broth}}, {{ing_03|oil}} and {{ing_04|wine}}, and stew it."
    },
    {
      "step": 2,
      "text": "Chop {{ing_05|onions}} and {{ing_06|coriander}} fine and add {{ing_07|brains}} [calf’s or pork, parboiled] the skin and nerves removed, to the {{ing_01|chicken}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 3,
      "text": "When this is cooked take [the {{ing_01|chicken}}] out and bone it."
    },
    {
      "step": 4,
      "text": "The {{ing_08|peas}} cook separately, without seasoning, only using chopped {{ing_05|onions}} and {{ing_06|coriander}} and the {{ing_02|broth}} of the {{ing_01|chicken}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 5,
      "text": "Strain [part of] the {{ing_08|peas}} and arrange them alternately [in a dish with the pieces of {{ing_01|chicken}}, {{ing_07|brains}} and the unstrained {{ing_08|peas}}]."
    },
    {
      "step": 6,
      "text": "Then crush {{ing_09|pepper}} and {{ing_10|cumin}}, moistened with {{ing_02|chicken broth}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 7,
      "text": "In the mortar beat {{ing_11|2 eggs}} with {{ing_02|broth}} to taste, pour this over the {{ing_01|chicken}} and {{ing_08|peas}}, finish on a slow fire [1], dish out on a heap of {{ing_08|peas}}, garnish with {{ing_12|pine nuts}} and serve."
    }
  ],
